name: shadow-dev-workflow
description: Self-contained development workflow with 3-tier knowledge base — propose → apply → review → release → archive with packaged planning, domain-model-driven specs, invariant-based verification, and knowledge-driven design constraints. Zero external workflow dependencies.

interface.shortDescription: Knowledge 驱动的开发工作流五段式管线
interface.longDescription: 以 active Knowledge 驱动的 propose → apply → review → release → archive 工作流：需求对齐做领域对齐（限界上下文与不变量）并产出 brief、按 brief 以不变量观察点执行分级验证与依赖调度、质量门禁验收模型一致性、知识闭环后提交发布 PR、合并后归档并重建 INDEX。另含 hotfix 快车道、知识库查询与 UI 设计提案伴侣。
defaultPrompt: 新需求：按 shadow-dev-propose 对齐需求并产出 brief
按当前 brief 开始执行（shadow-dev-apply）
对本次改动做质量门禁（shadow-dev-review）
